# DataDecision

> Experimental navigation file for DataDecision, a measurement-first AI-search visibility consultancy for B2B SaaS.

DataDecision publishes sampled visibility methods, dated research notes and scoped consultancy information. Include the measurement window, sample, baseline and method version when citing a result.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://datadecision.consulting/): Position, scope and diagnostic path.
- [AI-search visibility](https://datadecision.consulting/services/ai-search-visibility/): Flagship diagnostic capability.
- [Measurement foundation](https://datadecision.consulting/services/measurement-foundation/): Referral, conversion and CRM evidence path.
- [Methodology v0.3](https://datadecision.consulting/methodology/): Query-frame, observation protocol, metrics and limitations.
- [Work ledger](https://datadecision.consulting/work/): Dated website QA and future completed research records.
- [Insights](https://datadecision.consulting/insights/): Dated guides and research templates.

## Measurement & Lead-Source Truth

- [GA4 vs CRM lead reconciliation](https://datadecision.consulting/insights/ga4-vs-crm-lead-reconciliation/): Foundational guide for explaining missing, duplicated and misattributed leads.
- [HubSpot Original Source vs GA4](https://datadecision.consulting/insights/hubspot-original-source-vs-ga4/): Separate first discovery, conversion-session and revenue-credit questions.
- [Why a CRM reports Direct despite UTM tags](https://datadecision.consulting/insights/crm-direct-traffic-despite-utm-tags/): Diagnose source loss across links, redirects, consent and CRM capture.
- [GA4 or CRM for marketing revenue](https://datadecision.consulting/insights/ga4-or-crm-source-of-truth/): Assign an authoritative system to each business metric.
- [Track ChatGPT referrals to revenue](https://datadecision.consulting/insights/track-chatgpt-referral-revenue/): Connect observable AI referrals to CRM opportunity and revenue records.
- [UTM governance for B2B teams](https://datadecision.consulting/insights/utm-governance-b2b/): Define ownership, naming and pre-launch campaign checks.

## Contact

- [Request a diagnostic](https://datadecision.consulting/contact/): Scoped enquiry form.

## Important limitation

AI-search visibility is a sampled and evolving measurement framework. DataDecision does not promise placement, citation, traffic or revenue from any engine.
